queries.query: Muzaffargarh Pakistan official cadastral parcel map land records GIS
queries.result: Found the official District Administration Muzaffargarh revenue pages, Punjab Land Records Authority, and PULSE official map/cadastral services. The PULSE ArcGIS REST configuration exposes a Muzaffargarh polygon layer; a bounded anonymous geometry query returned parcel polygons and safe IDs, while the exact unchanged WUP point returned zero features.

registry.custodian: Punjab Land Records Authority / Punjab PULSE official cadastral mapping service, with Muzaffargarh district revenue administration as local land-record context.
registry.localOffice: District Administration Muzaffargarh revenue administration and ADC (Revenue) pages evidence local maintenance of revenue/land records; the parcel geometry service is provincial PULSE/PLRA rather than a separately identified municipal GIS office.
registry.sourceScope: Official ArcGIS MapServer `VendorMaps/Punjab_Cdastral_Maps`, layer 22 named `Muzaffargarh`; bounded parcel geometry access was verified, but citywide completeness was not.
registry.geometryAccess: Anonymous public viewer token endpoint supplied a short-lived service token; the token value is not retained. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe owner/address fields, or TLS weakening was used.

geometry.exactWupPointTest: Performed without moving [30.0715511199714, 71.1925889605798]. The exact point query against layer 22 returned zero features; this is not treated as evidence of absence. A separate 0.04-degree envelope around the unchanged point returned 2,000 polygon features, equal to the service maxRecordCount.
geometry.crs: EPSG:4326 (WGS 84), explicitly reported by the Muzaffargarh layer/service metadata.
